summary: The filing is a Form 6-K reporting a routine quarterly cash dividend declaration by Bladex, Inc. The board approved a $0.6875 per share dividend payable August 25, 2026 to holders of record August 7, 2026. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, or similar special-situation elements. This is an ordinary dividend announcement, not a special situation event.
